title: MTS dual-prediction Bellman bound
quantifiers: Every initial state s_0 in M
Every sequence of nonnegative extended-real service costs c_t
Every prediction sequence w_hat_0,...,w_hat_T with w_hat_T identically zero
Every tie-breaking choice from the algorithm argmin
algorithm: At t choose s_t in argmin_s d(s_{t-1},s)+c_t(s)+w_hat_t(s).
zero_optimum_boundary: When OPT=0 the additive conclusion remains meaningful; the displayed ratio is undefined and is not asserted.
verdict_rule: VERIFIED only if the exact symbolic certificate, independent checker, source anchors, and rejection control all pass.
